```{python}
import pandas as pd
from itables import show
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.sort_values('date').copy()
df_sorted = df_sorted.groupby(['player_name','batterid']).agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted = df_sorted.sort_values(by='profit',ascending=False)
df_sorted['total_picks'] = df_sorted.over_picks + df_sorted.under_picks
df_sorted = df_sorted[['player_name','total_picks','profit']]
df_sorted = df_sorted.query('total_picks>1')
show(df_sorted,searching=False,ordering=True,showIndex=False)
```

```         
{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test.over_diff = final_ratings_test.over_diff.clip(lower=0)
final_ratings_test.under_diff = final_ratings_test.under_diff.clip(lower=0)
final_ratings_test['diff'] = final_ratings_test.under_diff+final_ratings_test.over_diff
final_ratings_test['diff_bin'] = pd.cut(final_ratings_test['diff'], bins=10)
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('diff_bin').agg(profit=('profit','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['diff_bin'] = df_sorted['diff_bin'].astype(str)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['diff_bin'],
    y=df_sorted['profit'],
    marker_color='steelblue',
    marker_line_color='white',
    marker_line_width=1
))
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Cumulative Units of Profit for Test Data
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.sort_values('date').copy()
df_sorted['date'] = df_sorted['date'].astype(str)
df_sorted = df_sorted.groupby('date').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['cumulative_profit'] = df_sorted['profit'].cumsum()
df_sorted['cumulative_profit'] = df_sorted['cumulative_profit']/10

fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_sorted['date'],
    y=df_sorted['cumulative_profit'],
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='steelblue', width=3)
)).update_layout(
    xaxis=dict(type='category', tickangle=45, nticks=10)
)
```
